title: Add kick transient response to audio controls
body:
Make a control respond to detected kick transients using the shared analyzer. User priority on 16 September: execute immediately after reviewed LUX150/151 integration, ahead of Library164/165.

Reuse the same bindings and input ownership. Add sensitivity, retrigger interval and a shaped envelope. Distinguish transient detection from tempo estimation; no automatic BPM inference.

Acceptance: reviewed analyzer prerequisite; repeatable fixtures and silence/noise checks; actual Studio response with independent tuning, save/reopen and graceful disconnect; preserve manual base and other bindings; independent review, integration and skill install/check. Record exact source and runtime evidence.

Reference: artifacts/refactor-audio-approved/brief.md.
reason: Record explicit user priority ahead of Library work
